name: control_key
description: Unique key for this control record (e.g. 'nightly_watermark')

name: last_successful_watermark
description: updated_at cutoff from the last successful pipeline run. NULL on first run.

name: last_run_at
description: Wall-clock time of the last successful pipeline completion.

name: last_run_order_count
description: Number of orders extracted on the last successful run.
